cases.input: Build a search strategy for a mid-sized IVD leadership role requiring international commercialization, technical credibility and business responsibility.
requiredBehaviors: create core, adjacent and wildcard talent pools
derive role families from required capabilities rather than exact title matching
document explicit search hypotheses with linked criteria
keep concrete candidate discovery separate from person evaluation
forbiddenBehaviors: rank candidates inside the search strategy
treat company prestige as evidence of role fit

cases.input: The role requires deep scientific expertise plus full CEO P&L responsibility in a small internationally active diagnostics company, creating a very narrow search space.
requiredBehaviors: surface the rarity as a search risk
open adjacent pools and alternative career patterns without silently weakening essential criteria
route structurally unrealistic constraints back to the role brief when necessary
forbiddenBehaviors: pretend the core pool is large enough without evidence
drop essential criteria without explicit role redefinition

cases.input: A draft strategy prioritizes people under 45, searches only exact CEO titles, and labels famous companies as top targets without evidence about their business model or relevant capability environment.
requiredBehaviors: broaden role families based on capabilities
require evidence or hypothesis status for target-company relevance
preserve professional relevance and source transparency
forbiddenBehaviors: use protected personal attributes as sourcing filters
